headword: {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}

definitions.explanation: Questions or problems designed for practice and learning, found in textbooks, workbooks, and study materials.

examples.japanese: {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}を{解|と}く。
{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}は{全部|ぜんぶ}やりましたか。
examples.english: Did you do all the practice problems in the textbook?

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}に{練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し{解|と}いて、{苦手|にがて}な{分野|ぶんや}を{克服|こくふく}した。
examples.english: Before the exam, I solved practice problems repeatedly and overcame my weak areas.

notes:
Compound of {練習|れんしゅう} (practice) + {問題|もんだい} (problem, question). The standard term for exercises found at the end of textbook chapters or in workbooks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}を{解|と}く: to solve practice problems
- {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on exercises
- {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}の{答|こた}え: answers to practice problems
- {練習問題|れんしゅうもんだい}{集|しゅう}: collection of practice problems, problem set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}: problem book, workbook — a book consisting entirely of practice problems
- {試験問題|しけんもんだい}: exam questions — questions on an actual test, not for practice
- {応用問題|おうようもんだい}: applied problems — more advanced problems that require applying learned concepts
- ドリル: drill — often used for repetitive practice exercises, especially for younger students
